notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 Query GALT and Query LITS time-bound surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies undefined initial bounds, bounds established by active time regulators, minimum lookahead behavior, pending advance grants, and the standard post-resignation and post-disconnect exception boundaries without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador Query GALT and Query LITS with time-regulation and time-advance callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador queryGALT/queryLITS and FederateAmbassador time-management declarations
